q1_issues.issue: (PartOf (sk_underside $x) nightmoth) puts the bare kind nightmoth in PartOf's whole slot instead of minting a per-thread moth witness, so each underside is asserted to be part of the kind rather than of a moth.

q2_gaps: kind-level part-whole inside a generic ('the undersides of nightmoths') — PartOf is defined only over an object's component or a group's member, and a generic definite plural has no group/witness treatment (the determiner rule assumes definite = specific)
notes: Compound handling (silken_thread genus plus the material-adjective modifier genus), the bare-plural verbal generic as a distributing rule at 0.9/0.9, and Source for 'from' are all correct. Patient on the intransitive subject is defensible as a non-volitional process.
